# KI: Deterministic Session Tree Branching & Compaction with UUIDv7

## Operational Summary
Linear chat histories fail when agents fork into speculative branches or sub-agent explorations. Organizing sessions as directed acyclic trees keyed by time-ordered UUIDv7 identifiers provides natural temporal index ordering in storage systems, deterministic ancestor traversal, and lossless branch compaction.
